rpcSemantics.signature: global_search(p_query TEXT, p_state_code TEXT DEFAULT NULL, p_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 20)
rpcSemantics.remediationNotes: Full-text search aggregation function across 4 public entities. Classified as Class A RPC Read.
Best-effort RPC incrementing aspirant modules_completed. Missing in SQL migration files; wrapped in try/catch on client. Must be migrated into POST /api/v1/aspirant/modules/:id/complete.
RPC incrementing short views. Falls back to direct table update on failure. Must be strangulated into Fastify POST /api/v1/shorts/:id/view.
Used inside .update({ view_count: supabase.rpc("increment") }) as fallback expression.
